interpretation_limits: Effects are conditional on V4 non-recovering risk and this historical universe.
An unchanged return does not prove a rule is useful: check whether it ever bound and whether selected securities changed.
Different cost assumptions change discrete orders and risk paths, so continuous returns need not decrease monotonically with cost.
No winning fixed configuration is substituted for the predeclared validation-selected primary strategy.
